cardOverview.overviewText: A corporate Platinum card crafted for large organizations, offering streamlined expense management, reporting tools, and rewards on bulk business expenses.

items.child: 4% off on Flights and Hotels Booking

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accidental death cover of ₹1 crore payable to the nominated kin.|Emergency medical expenses cover up to ₹1 lakh while travelling abroad.|Flight delay cover up to ₹15,000 for the primary cardholder.|Loss of checked baggage cover up to ₹15,000 for the primary cardholder.|Missed connecting international flight cover up to ₹15,000 for the primary cardholder.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.

benefitRows.name: MMT MyBiz
benefitRows.description: 4% off on Flights and Hotels Booking
benefitRows.offer: 4% off on flight and hotel bookings. Discounted fares, free meal and seat selection, and low fees for cancellation.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Book your flights and hotels on MMT MyBiz using HDFC Credit Card.
